profile_text.body:
Workday is a public company founded in 2005 and headquartered in Pleasanton, California. It trades under the ticker WDAY and files with the SEC under CIK 0001327811. Its most recent 10-K reported revenue of $9,552,000,000 for the period ending 2026-01-31. The company describes itself on its site as an enterprise AI platform for HR, finance, and IT, and markets Sana and agentic AI that it says can find, build, act, and automate rather than only assist.

Its tracked AI product is Workday AI, listed under ERP and business application AI. The company presents it as covering HR and finance AI, skills-based talent, and predictive analytics, and the product record notes sensitive HR data exposure as a consideration.

Workday appears in nine tracked court cases. These include Meckfessel Poletti v. Workday, Inc. in the District Court, E.D. California, Williams v. Workday, Inc. in the District Court, N.D. Georgia, Elias v. Workday, Inc. in the District Court, N.D. California, Noriega (PS) v. Workday, Inc. and Doe (PS) v. Workday, Inc. in the District Court, D. Colorado, Hill v. Workday, Inc. in the District Court, D. Maryland and the District Court, E.D. Virginia, and a second Meckfessel Poletti case in the District Court, E.D. California. California accounts for 281 of the tracked cases.
